features.title: Retrieval engine v1: chunk/entity/edge tables, hybrid retrieval + one-hop graph expansion, persona-core prompt
features.notes: Sources are chunked+embedded+entity-extracted inline at ingest (lib/retrieval/*); chat builds persona-core prompt + retrieved context for the visitor's question (buildSystemPrompt(query)). Embeddings: VOYAGE_API_KEY/OPENAI_API_KEY if set, else local hashed n-grams; hybrid BM25+cosine with EntityEdge one-hop expansion. Backfill: npx tsx scripts/reindex.ts. Proof: docs/features/retrieval-engine-v1/proof.ts (green); gate PASS; verified live in browser.

features.title: Graph tab: see and fix the extracted entity/relation graph
features.notes: Admin dashboard 'Graph' tab (app/admin/GraphPanel.tsx) over lib/retrieval/graph.ts: index-health stats (sources/chunks/entities/relations/orphans, plus warnings for missing embeddings and a mixed-embedding-model index), every entity with mention count + source titles + edge count, orphans flagged, and every relation. Fixes: rename/retype an entity (renaming onto an existing name MERGES them — mentions move, edges rewire, duplicates collapse, self-loops drop), delete entity, delete relation, add relation. Server actions are thin auth wrappers so the logic stays testable. Proof: docs/features/knowledge-graph-admin/proof.ts (28 assertions green); gate PASS. Not yet visually clicked through (admin login required).
features.next: Phase 2 continues: persona-aware entity ontology in lib/retrieval/entities.ts + persona-biased ranking.

features.title: Index every admin surface into one knowledge graph (profile, persona, projects, photos, knowledge, approved answers)
features.notes: Chunk gains originKind/originId/originLabel and sourceId becomes nullable, so the index is origin-agnostic (lib/retrieval/indexer.ts indexOrigin/dropOrigin). lib/retrieval/origins.ts turns each surface into indexable text and is triggered inline by the admin saves (saveProfile/uploadResume, savePersona, add/update/deleteProject, upload/update/deletePhoto, saveChatFeedback, deleteChatSession) — best-effort, never fails a save. ACTIVITY IS APPROVAL-GATED: only assistant answers rated up are indexed, because visitor-typed chat is untrusted input and would otherwise poison the KB. Prompt slimmed: bio/experience/project blurbs/photo descriptions are now retrieved, while identity, contact, persona, project id index and A2UI rules stay always-on. Graph tab shows an 'Indexed from' per-origin breakdown. Proof: docs/features/universal-knowledge-index/proof.ts (25 assertions green); prior three proofs still green; gate PASS.
features.next: Deploy + run `npx tsx scripts/reindex.ts --all` on production: existing prod chunks predate the origin columns and carry empty originId/originLabel until reindexed.

features.title: Visual graph view; Entities and Relations as paginated tabs
features.notes: app/admin/GraphView.tsx (client) adds three panes under the Graph tab: 'Visual graph' renders a force-directed SVG node-link diagram (Fruchterman-Reingold, deterministic circle seeding so it doesn't reshuffle on edits, iterations shed as n grows since it also runs during SSR) with nodes sized by mention count, coloured by entity type, orphans ringed red, click-to-isolate neighbours and a legend; 'Entities' and 'Relations' hold the editing UI, each paginated at 20. GraphPanel keeps stats + origin breakdown + health warnings. Also paced the backfill (EMBED_PACE_MS, default 21s between origins) because one embed request per origin back-to-back trips the provider per-minute limit; pacing lives in the backfill, not the embed layer, so live chat is never throttled. Gate PASS. Verified live: production reindexed to 21 chunks all on voyage-3.5-lite, 0 stale, and the chatbot now answers background questions from the profile origin.
features.next: Visual pane not yet clicked through by Claude (admin login required).

features.title: Persona: one free-prose field (collapsed from the 21-section persona + agent-behaviors catalogue); Persona and Theme split into two tabs
features.notes: lib/persona.ts is the catalogue, now a SINGLE section (`persona`) plus PERSONA_BLURB, the one-paragraph brief rendered above the field; the admin form, savePersona, and the chat prompt all iterate it. Stored as JSON in Profile.personaSections (map shape unchanged, no migration). The 21 template sections were retired 2026-07-26: they came from buyer-persona instruments whose fields (purchasing approval, budget cuts, onboarding tolerance, crisis mode) either don't apply to a personal site or can't be known without inventing them, and an invented section enters the prompt with the same authority as a true one. safePersonaSections folds any text stored under the 21 retired keys forward into the single field on read (LEGACY_SECTIONS, deletable once the live row is saved again), so prod persona text can't silently vanish. buildSystemPrompt renders the field verbatim with no headings; an empty field renders as "" so the hardcoded fallback still applies. Proof: docs/features/persona-sections/proof.ts (21 assertions green); tsc + next lint clean; admin markup verified server-rendered (one section_persona textarea, blurb present, zero retired labels).
features.next: Ingestion: fill the field from an uploaded document, existing knowledge, or sent email (see the persona-from-email design), incl. mapping the legacy persona/overview/values/tone columns.

features.title: Canned answers served with zero API calls; chat brain extracted to lib/brain.ts
features.notes: Two tiers only: a hand-written CannedAnswer table matched by normalized string equality (case, spacing, trailing punctuation ignored — nothing fuzzy) and served with no Anthropic call, then Haiku for everything else. No classifier call, no escalation, no second model — ruled out by Blake. Canned rows carry an optional cardTool/cardInput hydrated through the same path the model uses, so the projects starter still renders cards. Part two moved TOOLS/hydrate()/the streaming tool loop out of app/api/chat/route.ts (179 -> 54 lines) into lib/brain.ts as answer({message, history, sessionId, channel}) yielding {t:'text'|'card'} — the route is now only NDJSON, and a second channel needs a transport rather than a second brain. New admin 'Answers' tab (app/admin/AnswersPanel.tsx) bootstraps the 5 starters as blank rows; a blank answer falls through to the model, so the tab is safe half-finished. Saving onto an existing question merges rather than throwing a unique-constraint error, and seeding only fills an empty table so deleted starters stay deleted. Proof: docs/features/canned-answers-and-brain/proof.ts (38 assertions green, was red at import); gate PASS; tsc + eslint clean. Verified live in the browser: the projects chip returned the stored text instantly with hydrated cards and hits went 0 -> 1, and a non-canned question still streamed a real Haiku answer through /api/chat.
features.next: Deploy (prisma db push runs on start, so CannedAnswer is created automatically), then fill the five starter answers on the Answers tab — every one left blank is still costing a model call. Admin tab itself not yet clicked through by Claude (admin login required). The WhatsApp channel this refactor was for is still unbuilt.

features.notes: Blank Answers-tab rows draft themselves from the knowledge base (lib/answerDrafts.ts: buildSystemPrompt(question) + a stored-answer brief, no tools) when the dashboard loads, and a draft is served to visitors immediately with zero model calls — it is the same answer the chatbot would have given, only instant and free. CannedAnswer gains aiDraft (unreviewed marker, cleared by saving) and draftedAt (the auto pass gets one shot per row, ever, so a row Blake empties stays empty). Per-row Redraft button; failures are swallowed and retryable; a pass is capped at 8 rows and hands the page back at DRAFT_DEADLINE_MS (12s) while in-flight drafts still land. Proof: docs/features/ai-drafted-answers/proof.ts (22 assertions green, offline, 2.4s); gate PASS; verified live in the browser — the drafted starter answer is served instantly on the public chat.

features.title: Expose the agent to other agents over A2A, plus a hosted agent facts card
features.notes: The site is now callable by other AI agents, not just readable by people. Agent Card at /.well-known/agent-card.json (A2A v1.0 — the CURRENT spec; note v1.0 renamed nearly everything from the v0.3 shape most tutorials still show: supportedInterfaces replaces url/preferredTransport, PascalCase SendMessage replaces message/send, TASK_STATE_* replaces lowercase states, and the `kind` discriminator is gone). Both live generations are served: v1.0 and v0.3, negotiated by the A2A-Version header, with absent = 0.3 per §3.6.2, and the 0.3 card also at the legacy /.well-known/agent.json. Endpoints: /api/a2a (JSON-RPC + SSE) and /api/a2a/rest (HTTP+JSON), both thin wrappers over one dispatch() so the two bindings cannot drift. Methods: SendMessage, SendStreamingMessage, GetTask, ListTasks, CancelTask, SubscribeToTask; push-notification methods and the extended card return the specific -32003/-32004 the card's capabilities imply. NO SECOND BRAIN — lib/a2a/run.ts translates lib/brain.ts's {text,card} events into A2A messages/artifacts, and A2UI blocks become `data` parts, so a calling agent gets machine-readable projects instead of prose. New A2ATask table persists tasks in Postgres (an in-memory store would break GetTask across a redeploy) and contextId doubles as the chat sessionId, so agent traffic lands in Activity. Open by default but rate limited (A2A_RATE_LIMIT, default 30/min/IP); A2A_API_KEY closes it and the card then advertises the bearer scheme. Also /.well-known/agent-facts.json in NANDA AgentFacts format — self-hosted, with no fabricated audit claims (no evaluations block, certification.level = self-declared) — and a human /agent page linked from the homepage. Card and facts are both generated from the Profile row, so any site built from this template describes its own owner. Proof: docs/features/a2a-agent-interface/proof.ts (61 assertions green, zero Anthropic calls — it drives the real dispatcher over a seeded canned answer; verified red by breaking the 0.3 `final` flag and the card data-part). tsc + eslint clean. Verified live on the dev server: all three well-known docs 200, a real knowledge-base answer through /api/a2a, SSE streaming with card data parts, the REST binding on every path, non-blocking send + SubscribeToTask reattachment, and the /agent page in the browser.
features.next: Deploy — `prisma db push` runs on start, so A2ATask is created automatically on Railway. Set NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL on Railway or the card will advertise the wrong host. Not done: gRPC binding, Agent Card JWS signing (needs a key story), and the two stale agentcards.host39.org cards under blakemauri2@gmail.com, which are near-empty and point at a dead URL — decide whether to repoint them at /.well-known/agent-card.json or delete them.
